notes: There was no forge-project.json here at all until 2026-09-09; the other three projects had one and this did not.
The web app needs Node >= 22.4 (see src/ForceSignal.Web/package.json engines) because vitest.config.ts passes --no-experimental-webstorage.
Warnings-as-errors is on. A build with warnings is a failed build.
scripts/verify.ps1 and scripts/docker-smoke.ps1 are PowerShell and need pwsh, which is not on every machine here.
CONTENT POLICY: the engine owns procedures, the player owns every number those procedures read. Ship no rules numbers, default profiles or stat blocks - server or client.
